ego.behavior: The car signals a lane change, detects the approaching high-speed vehicle, and delays the maneuver until the overtaking vehicle has passed.

adversarials.behavior: The car approaches at high speed from behind in the ego's target lane and overtakes the ego vehicle.

requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must detect the rear-approaching high-speed vehicle and delay the lane change until the overtaking vehicle has safely passed; the scenario terminates once the lane change is completed or aborted.

Chronology: initial ego signals lane change with clear target lane; midpoint adversarial car rapidly closes from behind in target lane; ending ego aborts/delayes lane change until adversarial passes. 4.
